question: What will be the value of MPC (Marginal Propensity to Consume) if the consumer's consumption patterns change due to a change in income?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MPC = (ranging between 0 and 1).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Marginal Propensity to Consume:**

__
 
• It is the **ratio of change in consumption to change in income.**
 
• The value of MPC will fluctuate if changes in income cause the consumer's consumption habits to alter.
 
• The **value of MPC will range from 0 to 1 if the consumer's consumption patterns change due to a change in income.**
 
• It represents the proportion of additional income that is spent on consumption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MPC = 0 **implies that there is **no change in consumption despite a change in income.**
 
• **MPC = 1** implies that the consumer** spends all the additional income on consumption.**
 
• **MPC = More than 1** implies that the consumer is **spending more than what they earn.**
